channel.title: Grok Bot Shelf, newest bots
channel.description: Newest Grok Bot templates on Grok Bot Shelf.

item.title: 🎥 Workout Demo Builder by Jenna
item.description: Builds phone workout apps where each lift keeps a YouTube form demo with a saved start time, so Watch demo jumps straight to the cue. For anyone who wants that pattern without hunting for timestamps every set.
item.dc:creator: Jenna (@JennaLiftsLife)

item.title: ✨ Spark by iLytzki
item.description: Sends you one creative, power-user Grok Bot tip every day, based on an idea people shared on X and adapted to your own bots, with a copy-paste prompt and a small visual mock-up.
item.dc:creator: iLytzki (@iLytzki)

item.title: 🚗 Tesla Inventory Finder by JeebsTX
item.description: Finds new and Certified Pre-Owned Tesla Model 3, Model Y, and Cybertruck inventory near your ZIP code, walking you through Tesla's own filter steps and returning direct listing links with prices.
item.dc:creator: JeebsTX (@JeebsTX)

item.title: 🏆 Hackathon Hunter by Ace
item.description: Finds, verifies and tracks hackathons, AI and Web3 challenges, Kaggle contests, bounties and grants for your country, with concise scheduled reports.
item.dc:creator: Ace (@aceop_xyz)

item.title: 📚 Books by Jason
item.description: One book a week as six short morning reads with key ideas, stories, a quote, something to try and a quiz; each Sunday you pick next week's book.
item.dc:creator: Jason (@sproutmed)

item.title: 🧭 First Officer by Phillip
item.description: A chief of staff for people running several projects and a crew of AI bots: a daily briefing, tracking of loose ends and decisions, and coordination across your bots.
item.dc:creator: Phillip (@phillipggreen)

item.title: 💼 Career Agent by Phillip
item.description: A job-search partner that finds verified openings that fit you, tracks them, and prepares tailored, truthful applications. Nothing gets submitted without your OK.
item.dc:creator: Phillip (@phillipggreen)

item.title: 🏈 Football Research Analyst by Phillip
item.description: Evidence-based NFL and college football betting research: stats, injuries, verified odds, handicapper track records, and probability-first pick rankings.
item.dc:creator: Phillip (@phillipggreen)

item.title: 🐦 Budgie by Cill
item.description: A budget bot that keeps your budget in a local SQLite database, plans each paycheck, and forecasts debt payoff, assets, and net worth on a live dashboard.
item.dc:creator: Cill (@cillfore)

item.title: 🧑‍💼 Wainwright Manager by Ryan
item.description: Your hiring manager for Grok Bots. You pick the roles; it checks each persona, creates clear one-job teammates, and gets every new hire focused.
item.dc:creator: Ryan (@itsryanlenk)

item.title: 🛡️ Patch Alert by ollie
item.description: Tell it what software you use and it checks CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list daily, alerting you only when something you run is being actively exploited.
item.dc:creator: ollie (@howdyollie)

item.title: 🔔 Tender Watch by ollie
item.description: Tell it what you sell and where, and it sets itself up, checks official public sources on weekday mornings, and messages you only when new tenders match.
item.dc:creator: ollie (@howdyollie)

item.title: 📑 Bid Desk by ollie
item.description: Paste a government tender (text, link or screenshot) and get a plain-words bid, no-bid or maybe verdict with eligibility flags, deadline and effort.
item.dc:creator: ollie (@howdyollie)

item.title: 🚐 RivetRoad Trip Planner by Salty FL Cracker
item.description: A friendly RV trip planner from RivetRoad.com that finds a rental rig, plans an RV-friendly route and campgrounds, and totals the real costs. Great for first-timers, with step-by-step driving confidence coaching.
item.dc:creator: Salty FL Cracker (@the_seth_ard)

item.title: 🤝 Creator Partnerships & Brand Deal HQ by Lisa
item.description: Sorts incoming sponsorship and brand deal offers, checks invoices, and tracks every deal for creators.
item.dc:creator: Lisa (@LisaMAUSA)

item.title: ⚡ Tesla FSD & EV True Cost-to-Own Coach by Lisa
item.description: Compares the true cost of owning gas cars vs. EVs, works out whether FSD pays off for you, and helps tune your EV insurance.
item.dc:creator: Lisa (@LisaMAUSA)

item.title: 🚗 Car Dealership & Mechanic Quote Auditor by Lisa
item.description: Checks dealer out-the-door quotes, lease terms, and repair estimates line by line, then gives you counter-offer scripts.
item.dc:creator: Lisa (@LisaMAUSA)

item.title: 📊 Sunday Open Brief by Yossi
item.description: Pre-open market catch-up: what moved across markets, stocks, and sectors, plus an open-bias card for the week ahead.
item.dc:creator: Yossi (@josephstayhappy)

item.title: 📈 X Hit Pattern Scanner by nahjuin
item.description: Scans a watchlist of X accounts for posts that are taking off, explains the patterns behind them, and drafts 3–5 original angles for you.
item.dc:creator: nahjuin (@nahjuin)

item.title: ✍️ Postwright by Calix
item.description: Turns your week of real work into X post drafts in your own voice, with sources and suggested posting times. Never posts for you.
item.dc:creator: Calix (@CaliLumberJack)

item.title: 🏋️ Fitness Coach by Jenna
item.description: Evidence-based fat-loss and lifting coach: sets calorie and macro targets, coaches progressive overload, tracks weekly weigh-in trends, and helps you stick to the plan when evenings get hard.
item.dc:creator: Jenna

item.title: 🚨 Scam Guard by Sarah
item.description: Family scam defense: sets up a family safe word, gives a Safe/Caution/Scam verdict on any call, text, email, link, or DM, watches your X DMs, and helps you get off data-broker sites. Never acts without your OK.
item.dc:creator: Sarah

item.title: ✍️ Prompt Upgrader by Sarah
item.description: Paste a rough prompt and get it scored, rewritten, explained, and tested, with short and detailed versions to copy. Keeps a searchable library of your best prompts, plus an optional daily tip.
item.dc:creator: Sarah

item.title: 🛳️ Cora — Cruise Planner & Loyalty Perks Tracker by Bill
item.description: End-to-end cruise planner: true sail-away totals, quiet-cabin deck checks, docked vs. tender port timelines, booking countdowns, and loyalty status and perks tracked across cruise lines.
item.dc:creator: Bill (@wjenson)

item.title: ✈️ Tammy — True-Total Travel & Points Scout by Bill
item.description: Flight, hotel, and award scout that exposes hidden resort and Basic Economy fees, checks fares on airline sites, does the credit-card points math, and watches booked trips for price-drop eCredits.
item.dc:creator: Bill (@wjenson)

item.title: 🎭 Facewright by Calix
item.description: Turns one approved photo of you into short anime or cinematic videos where your face stays the same in every shot. Uses Grok Imagine in your own signed-in browser and never posts anything.
item.dc:creator: Calix (@CaliLumberJack)

item.title: 🕵️ Social Media Auditor by Jenny Marquis
item.description: Audits your own social media post archives and flags privacy and safety risks. Looks only at your public posts, never posts, deletes, or searches the web about you. You approve every change.
item.dc:creator: Jenny Marquis (@JennyMarquis)

item.title: 🖌️ Design by lu
item.description: Background design specialist for UI, CSS and animation, three.js scenes, charts, icons, mockups, and images. Makes the asset, checks it visually, and explains the choice in one line.
item.dc:creator: lu

item.title: 🏚️ Shed Sales Pipeline by FringeSignalX
item.description: Prospecting and lead follow-up for local dealers of sheds and portable buildings: finds prospects on the public web and drafts first messages, check-ins, and call scripts for your approval.
item.dc:creator: FringeSignalX (@FringeSignalX)

item.title: 🎬 Tubewright by Calix
item.description: Turns a finished video's transcript into a draft upload kit: titles in your voice, an SEO description, real-timestamp chapters, thumbnail concepts, a pinned comment, and an X clip thread.
item.dc:creator: Calix (@CaliLumberJack)

item.title: 🎒 Parent Radar by Calix
item.description: Watches your kid's school email, class apps, and grades. Leads with what to do today, flags grade trends early, and adds school events to your calendar only when you say yes.
item.dc:creator: Calix (@CaliLumberJack)

item.title: 🌳 Family History by Raina Hornaday
item.description: A warm genealogy researcher that builds your family tree from public records, cites every fact, and turns stories into tree posters and old-time newspapers.
item.dc:creator: Raina Hornaday

item.title: 📰 Household Herald by Raina Hornaday
item.description: Reads your email and calendar so school forms, family plans, and bills don't slip — weekday digests and a printable kitchen newspaper, draft-only.
item.dc:creator: Raina Hornaday

item.title: 🔥 IT Resume Roaster by nahjuin
item.description: Honest, Reddit-style feedback on your IT resume without posting it publicly: ranked problems and exact fixes.
item.dc:creator: nahjuin (@nahjuin)

item.title: 🩸 T1D Helper by Dean
item.description: A free type 1 diabetes helper: carb estimates from food photos, check-in alerts, glucose patterns, and clinic prep.
item.dc:creator: Dean (@DeanCockett)

item.title: 📈 X Growth Coach by Ivan
item.description: Set an X follower goal; it checks your analytics each morning, explains your posts, and scores your drafts.
item.dc:creator: Ivan (@0ooooo0)

item.title: 🎄 Christmas Card Bot by Christine
item.description: Plans, writes, and orders your holiday cards: cleans your list, drafts greetings, and sets mail-by dates.
item.dc:creator: Christine (@BurkevonRiddern)

item.title: 📺 VibeYourTV by orpheuzkaze
item.description: Sets up your Android TV or Google TV from your PC over Wi-Fi with adb, with a reversible debloat.
item.dc:creator: orpheuzkaze (@orpheuskaze)

item.title: 🎟️ Alphabot Raffle Bot by orpheuzkaze
item.description: Creates Alphabot collab raffles from partner docs, then pulls the winners into Google Sheets.
item.dc:creator: orpheuzkaze (@orpheuskaze)

item.title: 🏈 Fantasy Sports by Chef
item.description: Sets fantasy football and basketball lineups and suggests adds, drops and trades on ESPN, Yahoo or Sleeper, with your OK.
item.dc:creator: Chef

item.title: 🛡️ Bot Budget Guard by MikeysMolecules
item.description: Keeps a team of Grok Bots inside a weekly usage budget.
item.dc:creator: MikeysMolecules (@MikeysMolecules)

item.title: 🎨 Art Bot by MikeysMolecules
item.description: A creative director that builds your brand style guide and keeps visuals on-brand.
item.dc:creator: MikeysMolecules (@MikeysMolecules)

item.title: 📈 Growth Coach by MikeysMolecules
item.description: Tracks your daily X growth pace and gives feedback on your posts. Read-only.
item.dc:creator: MikeysMolecules (@MikeysMolecules)

item.title: 🔎 Dig by iLytzki
item.description: Deep research on any question, with sources and diagrams.
item.dc:creator: iLytzki (@iLytzki)

item.title: ⛏️ Solo Pleb by Bolster_15
item.description: Watches your solo Bitcoin miner, pool and node, and pings you on notable events. Never moves money.
item.dc:creator: Bolster_15 (@Bolster_15)

item.title: 🥊 Contrarian by CaliLumberJack
item.description: A thinking partner that argues the other side of your plan and runs a pre-mortem before you commit.
item.dc:creator: CaliLumberJack (@CaliLumberJack)

item.title: 🎬 Podcast Clipper for X by wayneb
item.description: Turns a podcast or YouTube episode into 8 to 12 captioned square clips, each with an X post draft.
item.dc:creator: wayneb (@wayneb)

item.title: 🔭 Rivaldo bot by nahjuin
item.description: Scans public X three times a day for popular, active accounts worth following in your niches.
item.dc:creator: nahjuin (@nahjuin)

item.title: 💼 First AI Side Job by Bella
item.description: Helps you pick one simple AI side job and walks you to a first paying client, with scam warnings.
item.dc:creator: Bella (@drbellahqw)

item.title: 🎓 Study Abroad Scholarship Finder by Bella
item.description: Finds study-abroad scholarships open now for your course and country, with links and deadlines.
item.dc:creator: Bella (@drbellahqw)
